questions.statement: Which is the best opening sentence for an argumentative essay?
questions.context: Redaccion de ensayos argumentativos, San Salvador.

options.text: School uniforms should be replaced by a dress code based on comfort.
options.feedback: It states the topic and the writer's position in one clear thesis.

options.text: There are many opinions about school clothes.
options.feedback: It only announces a topic without taking a position.

options.text: This essay will talk about uniforms.
options.feedback: A metadiscourse announcement adds no content.

options.text: Uniforms are worn every day by millions of students.
options.feedback: It gives a fact but does not present an argument.

questions.explanation:
Una buena tesis presenta el tema y anticipa la posicion del autor de forma clara y directa.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does a thesis statement do in an argumentative essay?

options.text: It lists every source used.
options.feedback: References belong in the bibliography, not in the thesis.

options.text: It concludes the argument with a summary.
options.feedback: That is the role of the conclusion.

options.text: It states the central argument of the essay.
options.feedback: The thesis is the claim the whole text supports.

options.text: It introduces the author's biography.
options.feedback: Biographical information is not part of the thesis.

questions.explanation:
La tesis declara la posicion central del ensayo y guia todo el desarrollo posterior.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the best linking word: 'The policy is expensive. ____, it improves results.'
questions.context: Conectores en el ensayo, San Miguel.

options.text: Therefore
options.feedback: 'Therefore' would draw a conclusion, not a contrast.

options.text: However
options.feedback: 'However' introduces a contrast between cost and improved results.

options.text: Besides
options.feedback: 'Besides' adds supporting information, which is not the relation here.

options.text: For example
options.feedback: 'For example' introduces an illustration, not an opposing idea.

questions.explanation:
'However' introduce una idea opuesta: el costo se opone al beneficio. Los conectores de contraste aunque pueden ser 'nevertheless' o 'yet'.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which is the best concluding sentence?

options.text: There are many reasons to think about school uniforms.
options.feedback: That is a vague repetition, not a conclusion.

options.text: I will now write about the second reason.
options.feedback: That is a metadiscourse remark and breaks the conclusion.

options.text: For these reasons, schools should adopt flexible dress codes.
options.feedback: It restates the argument and closes the essay without new evidence.

options.text: Uniforms cost ten dollars per year.
options.feedback: A new fact at the end distracts from the argument.

questions.explanation:
Una buena conclusion retoma la tesis y la amplia con una implicacion, sin introducir argumentos nuevos.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What is the main purpose of a counterargument paragraph?

options.text: To weaken the essay by confusing the reader.
options.feedback: The purpose is to strengthen, not to confuse.

options.text: To present the strongest objection and then answer it.
options.feedback: Addressing an objection makes the argument more convincing.

options.text: To repeat the thesis in other words.
options.feedback: Repetition of the thesis is not a counterargument.

options.text: To list unrelated sources.
options.feedback: Sources are cited to support a position, not listed randomly.

questions.explanation:
El contraargumento presenta la objecion mas fuerte y la refuta, fortaleciendo la tesis del autor.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the best thesis statement for an essay about remote learning.

options.text: Remote learning is a topic that many people discuss.
options.feedback: It only announces a topic and cannot be argued.

options.text: Remote learning is used in many countries.
options.feedback: It is a fact, not a debatable claim.

options.text: Remote learning changed education.
options.feedback: It is too vague to serve as an argument.

options.text: Remote learning improves independence but requires better internet access.
options.feedback: It takes a clear position that can be defended with evidence on both sides.

questions.explanation:
Una tesis argumentative debe ser una afirmacion clara, discutible y sostenida por argumentos.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence is the most objective in a formal argumentative essay?

options.text: The terrible old system never worked for anyone.
options.feedback: 'Terrible' and 'never' are judgements, not evidence.

options.text: Two studies published in 2020 reported improved attendance.
options.feedback: It presents verifiable data with no emotional judgement.

options.text: Everyone knows that online classes are fantastic.
options.feedback: 'Everyone knows' and 'fantastic' are subjective and unverified.

options.text: Obviously, the new method is the best option.
options.feedback: 'Obviously' assumes the conclusion instead of arguing it.

questions.explanation:
La objetividad se expresa con datos verificables y sin adjetivos valorativos; las otras opciones contienen juicios.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What does the phrase 'In conclusion' signal to the reader?

options.text: The writer is starting a new paragraph.
options.feedback: It signals the end, not the beginning.

options.text: The writer is quoting a source.
options.feedback: Quotations need reference markers, not a linking phrase.

options.text: The writer is summarising the argument.
options.feedback: 'In conclusion' marks the synthesising part of the text.

options.text: The writer is asking a question.
options.feedback: Questions use question forms, not this connective.

questions.explanation:
La expresion anuncia el cierre del ensayo y la sintesis final de los argumentos. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which evidence is most appropriate for an essay arguing that schools should recycle more?

options.text: Recycling is a wonderful idea.
options.feedback: That is an opinion repeated from the thesis.

options.text: I think everyone should recycle.
options.feedback: A personal preference does not support an argument.

options.text: Some people do not like bins in the corridors.
options.feedback: An irrelevant personal reaction, not evidence.

options.text: The amount of electricity saved by recycling paper last year.
options.feedback: Measurable data directly supports the claim.

questions.explanation:
Una cifra sobre kilowatios de energia ahorrada es evidencia cuantitativa y verificable; las demas son opiniones.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the best transition between paragraphs on different aspects of the same topic.

options.text: Furthermore, schools should reduce paper waste.
options.feedback: It adds a further point without breaking the topic.

options.text: In conclusion, recycling is a good practice.
options.feedback: That signals the end, which is not a mid-text transition.

options.text: For example, I have three brothers.
options.feedback: The personal detail breaks the line of argument.

options.text: On the other hand, that was a different school.
options.feedback: The contrast introduces an unrelated setting.

questions.explanation:
'Furthermore' anade un argumento adicional al ya presentado dentro del mismo tema. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What is the main difference between an argumentative and a descriptive essay?

options.text: The descriptive essay always includes statistics.
options.feedback: Statistics belong to argumentative texts.

options.text: The argumentative essay has no structure.
options.feedback: Both genres require an organised structure.

options.text: The descriptive essay presents a conclusion.
options.feedback: Both genres normally end with a closing paragraph.

options.text: An argumentative essay defends a position; a descriptive one explains characteristics.
options.feedback: The first argues, the second depicts.

questions.explanation:
El ensayo argumentativo defiende una posicion con razones; el descriptivo explica caracteristicas de algo.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence is a clear topic sentence for a paragraph about renewable energy?

options.text: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
options.feedback: It announces the general idea the paragraph will develop.

options.text: My uncle installed panels on his roof.
options.feedback: A single specific case is too narrow for a topic sentence.

options.text: Panels are useful because they reduce bills and emissions.
options.feedback: This already gives the reasons, which belong after the topic sentence.

options.text: Panels.
options.feedback: A single word cannot announce the content of a paragraph.

questions.explanation:
Una oracion de tema anuncia de forma general lo que el parrafo va a explicar. Suele ocupar la primera frase del parrafo.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Why should an essay include a short introduction of the topic before the thesis?

options.text: To fill space so the essay looks longer.
options.feedback: Padding is not a rhetorical reason.

options.text: To give the reader background so the thesis makes sense.
options.feedback: Context first, claim second is the standard order.

options.text: To list all the sources used.
options.feedback: Sources are cited in the body, not listed as background.

options.text: To repeat the conclusion twice.
options.feedback: Repeating a conclusion is not a function of the introduction.

questions.explanation:
La introduccion situacion el tema en su contexto para que la tesis tenga sentido para el lector.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which verb is more precise in an academic essay: 'The results ____ a clear improvement.'

options.text: show
options.feedback: 'Show' indicates evidence without claiming absolute proof.

options.text: prove
options.feedback: 'Prove' claims certainty, which empirical results rarely support.

options.text: guess
options.feedback: 'Guess' contradicts the factual register of the sentence.

options.text: feel
options.feedback: 'Feel' is subjective and does not fit academic writing.

questions.explanation:
'Show' presenta evidencia visible; 'prove' es demasiado fuerte para datos que podrian tener otra explicacion.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Identify the error in this thesis: 'Recycling should definitely be good for everyone everywhere.'
questions.context: Deteccion de errores en la tesis, San Salvador.

options.text: The thesis is too short to be valid.
options.feedback: Length does not determine the validity of a thesis.

options.text: It should end with a question mark.
options.feedback: A thesis is a statement, not a question.

options.text: The absolutes make the claim impossible to argue precisely.
options.feedback: 'Definitely', 'good' and 'everyone' remove any space for qualification.

options.text: It needs a quotation in the middle.
options.feedback: Quotations belong to the body of the essay.

questions.explanation:
La tesis es demasiado absoluta y general: 'definitely', 'good' y 'everyone' impiden argumentar con precision.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the best way to refute an opponent's argument.

options.text: Repeat the opponent's words louder.
options.feedback: Volume does not refute an argument logically.

options.text: Change the subject quickly.
options.feedback: Avoiding the issue leaves the objection unanswered.

options.text: Call the author a poor writer.
options.feedback: Personal attacks are a fallacy, not an argument.

options.text: Point out that its evidence does not support its conclusion.
options.feedback: A refutation attacks the link between evidence and claim.

questions.explanation:
Una refutacion solida se apoya en la logica del argumento contrario: se muestra que la evidencia presentada no sostiene la conclusion que el oponente extrae, sin recurrir a insultos ni a cambios de tema.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which paragraph usually contains the main argument in a five-paragraph essay?
questions.context: Estructura del ensayo de cinco parrafos, San Salvador.

options.text: The second paragraph.
options.feedback: The body paragraph carries the thesis and its supporting evidence.

options.text: The first paragraph.
options.feedback: The first paragraph is the introduction.

options.text: The last paragraph.
options.feedback: The last paragraph is the conclusion.

options.text: Any paragraph at random.
options.feedback: Structure follows a deliberate order, not randomness.

questions.explanation:
En el esquema clasico, el segundo parrafo es el cuerpo donde se desarrolla la tesis con evidencias.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: What should you avoid when quoting a source in an academic essay?

options.text: Quoting a sentence of fewer than eight words.
options.feedback: Short quotations are acceptable when they are attributed.

options.text: Using a quote to support your own argument.
options.feedback: That is a legitimate and common use of evidence.

options.text: Quoting without naming the author or the year.
options.feedback: An unattributed quote cannot be verified by the reader.

options.text: Introducing the quote with a colon.
options.feedback: A colon is the standard way to introduce a quotation.

questions.explanation:
Una cita sin autor ni ano es una cita no verificable; ademas debe integrarse en la propia redaccion.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the best title for an essay about the benefits of public transport.

options.text: Essay About Transport
options.feedback: It is too vague to inform the reader of the content.

options.text: Why Buses Beat Cars in City Streets
options.feedback: It names the topic and signals a comparative argument.

options.text: The Second Essay of the Year
options.feedback: It refers to the assignment, not to the content.

options.text: Things I Like
options.feedback: It does not identify the subject matter at all.

questions.explanation:
Un buen titulo anuncia el tema y el enfoque del texto de forma breve y precisa. Es uno de los puntos mas frecuentes de las pruebas de esta unidad.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence expresses an opinion clearly and appropriately for an argumentative essay?

options.text: Later start times are obviously the truth.
options.feedback: 'Obviously' asserts the claim as fact and gives no reason.

options.text: Everyone knows that teenagers prefer late classes.
options.feedback: 'Everyone knows' is an unsupported generalisation.

options.text: Later start times reduce stress.
options.feedback: Stated alone, it reads as a fact rather than an argued opinion.

options.text: In my view, later start times would reduce stress for teenagers.
options.feedback: It marks the position as an opinion and gives a reason.

questions.explanation:
Una opinion argumentative se enuncia con 'In my view' y se apoya en una razon, no como un hecho aislado.
